name: Plutonium T5 (Black Ops 1)
author: vrrdnt@users.noreply.github.com
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 dedicated server powered by the Plutonium client, running under Wine. Supports both multiplayer (t5mp) and zombies (t5sp - yes, 'sp', because Plutonium hosts BO1 zombies via the singleplayer engine). Installs the xerxes-at/T5ServerConfig dedicated.cfg and dedicated_sp.cfg templates. Pre-creates the storage/t5/logs/ directory because T5 has a known bug where it does not auto-create them. Clients connect via session IDs from Plutonium's backend, not direct IP. T5 ZM RCon support is partial - log monitoring works for IW4MAdmin, but remote !commands are unreliable. Requires legally-owned BO1 game files in /home/container/game/ and a T5MP or T5SP server key.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plutonium T5 (Black Ops 1) - Pelican install script
# Runs in the installer container; server dir is /mnt/server, mapped to
# /home/container at runtime.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set -e

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates tar unzip file git

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
PLUTO_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/plutonium"
GAME_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/game"
STORAGE_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/storage/t5"
DEFAULTS_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/default-configs"
SCRIPTS_DIR="${STORAGE_DIR}/scripts"

mkdir -p "${PLUTO_DIR}" "${GAME_DIR}" "${STORAGE_DIR}" "${DEFAULTS_DIR}" \
    "${SCRIPTS_DIR}/mp" "${STORAGE_DIR}/logs"

# Pre-create both possible log files. T5 has a known bug where it does NOT
# auto-create the log directory or file, and silently produces no log output
# without them. Confirmed across multiple Plutonium forum threads.
touch "${STORAGE_DIR}/logs/games_mp.log"
touch "${STORAGE_DIR}/logs/games_zm.log"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fetch mxve/plutonium-updater.rs.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "[install] Locating latest plutonium-updater release..."
UPDATER_URL=$(curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/mxve/plutonium-updater.rs/releases/latest \
    | grep '"browser_download_url"' \
    | grep -Ei 'linux' \
    | grep -vi 'arm\|aarch\|musl\|sha' \
    | grep -E '\.tar\.gz"' \
    | head -1 \
    | cut -d '"' -f 4)

if [ -z "${UPDATER_URL}" ]; then
    echo "[install] Could not locate plutonium-updater linux asset. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[install] Downloading: ${UPDATER_URL}"
curl -sL "${UPDATER_URL}" -o /tmp/updater.tar.gz
mkdir -p /tmp/updater-extract
tar -xzf /tmp/updater.tar.gz -C /tmp/updater-extract

UPDATER_BIN=$(find /tmp/updater-extract -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'plutonium-updater*' -executable | head -1)
if [ -z "${UPDATER_BIN}" ]; then
    UPDATER_BIN=$(find /tmp/updater-extract -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'plutonium-updater*' | head -1)
fi
if [ -z "${UPDATER_BIN}" ]; then
    echo "[install] Could not find plutonium-updater binary in extracted archive."
    ls -la /tmp/updater-extract
    exit 1
fi

mv "${UPDATER_BIN}" "${PLUTO_DIR}/plutonium-updater"
chmod +x "${PLUTO_DIR}/plutonium-updater"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull Plutonium bootstrap files (mirrors all 4 games).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "[install] Fetching Plutonium bootstrap files..."
( cd "${PLUTO_DIR}" && ./plutonium-updater -d . --no-color )

if [ ! -f "${PLUTO_DIR}/bin/plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe" ]; then
    echo "[install] plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe missing after updater run. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clone xerxes-at/T5ServerConfig and stage both cfgs as templates.
#
# Layout:
#   localappdata/Plutonium/storage/t5/dedicated.cfg     - MP cfg
#   localappdata/Plutonium/storage/t5/dedicated_sp.cfg  - ZM cfg (NOTE: _sp not _zm)
#
# Both are templated; entrypoint transforms the active one based on
# SERVER_CONFIG and seeds it into storage/t5/.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "[install] Cloning xerxes-at/T5ServerConfig..."
rm -rf /tmp/t5cfg
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/xerxes-at/T5ServerConfig.git /tmp/t5cfg

XERXES_T5="/tmp/t5cfg/localappdata/Plutonium/storage/t5"
if [ ! -d "${XERXES_T5}" ]; then
    echo "[install] Unexpected repo layout; ${XERXES_T5} missing."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[install] Staging dedicated.cfg and dedicated_sp.cfg as templates..."
cp "${XERXES_T5}/dedicated.cfg"     "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/dedicated.cfg.template"
cp "${XERXES_T5}/dedicated_sp.cfg"  "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/dedicated_sp.cfg.template"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: install Resxt's T5 mapvote (MP only - he gave up on T5 ZM).
# Two files, both go to storage/t5/scripts/mp/.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "${INSTALL_MAPVOTE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[install] INSTALL_MAPVOTE=1 -> installing Resxt T5 mapvote (MP only)..."
    MV_BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Resxt/Plutonium-T5-Scripts/main/mapvote"
    curl -fsSL "${MV_BASE}/mapvote.gsc"           -o "${SCRIPTS_DIR}/mp/mapvote.gsc"           || echo "[install] WARN: mapvote.gsc download failed"
    curl -fsSL "${MV_BASE}/mapvote_mp_extend.gsc" -o "${SCRIPTS_DIR}/mp/mapvote_mp_extend.gsc" || echo "[install] WARN: mapvote_mp_extend.gsc download failed"
else
    echo "[install] INSTALL_MAPVOTE=0 -> skipping mapvote install."
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: install ineedbots/bo1_bot_warfare v1.1.1.
# Release zip layout:
#   Move to root of Black Ops folder/mods/mp_bots/mp_bots.iwd
# For dedicated server: copy mp_bots.iwd to storage/t5/mods/mp_bots/, then
# extract its maps/ folder to storage/t5/maps/ (per Plutonium forum guide
# https://forum.plutonium.pw/topic/22385).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "${INSTALL_BOTWARFARE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[install] INSTALL_BOTWARFARE=1 -> installing BO1 Bot Warfare v1.1.1..."
    curl -fsSL -L "https://github.com/ineedbots/bo1_bot_warfare/releases/download/v1.1.1/bo1bw111.zip" \
        -o /tmp/bo1bw.zip || echo "[install] WARN: BW zip download failed"
    if [ -f /tmp/bo1bw.zip ]; then
        rm -rf /tmp/bo1bw-extract
        unzip -q /tmp/bo1bw.zip -d /tmp/bo1bw-extract
        IWD="/tmp/bo1bw-extract/Move to root of Black Ops folder/mods/mp_bots/mp_bots.iwd"
        if [ -f "${IWD}" ]; then
            mkdir -p "${STORAGE_DIR}/mods/mp_bots"
            cp "${IWD}" "${STORAGE_DIR}/mods/mp_bots/mp_bots.iwd"
            # Extract iwd's maps/ to storage/t5/maps/ for dedicated server use
            rm -rf /tmp/bo1bw-iwd
            mkdir -p /tmp/bo1bw-iwd
            unzip -q "${IWD}" -d /tmp/bo1bw-iwd
            if [ -d /tmp/bo1bw-iwd/maps ]; then
                mkdir -p "${STORAGE_DIR}/maps"
                cp -r /tmp/bo1bw-iwd/maps/* "${STORAGE_DIR}/maps/" 2>/dev/null || true
                echo "[install] Bot Warfare maps/ extracted to storage/t5/maps/"
            else
                echo "[install] WARN: maps/ folder not found inside mp_bots.iwd"
            fi
            echo "[install] Bot Warfare installed."
        else
            echo "[install] WARN: mp_bots.iwd missing from release archive."
        fi
    fi
else
    echo "[install] INSTALL_BOTWARFARE=0 -> skipping Bot Warfare install."
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Write the runtime entrypoint.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/entrypoint.sh" <<'__PLUTO_ENTRYPOINT__'
#!/bin/bash
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plutonium T5 (Black Ops 1) server entrypoint for Pelican
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Env vars provided by the egg:
#   PLUTO_KEY         Server key from https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys
#                     (must be T5MP or T5SP key matching GAME_MODE)
#   GAME_MODE         t5mp | t5sp     (NOTE: t5sp for zombies, NOT t5zm)
#   SERVER_CONFIG     dedicated.cfg | dedicated_sp.cfg
#   SERVER_PORT       UDP port Wings allocated (default 28960)
#   SERVER_NAME       Hostname injected into cfg sv_hostname
#   IW4M_IP           IW4MAdmin host IP. Empty = rcon wide open.
#   FS_GAME           mod folder under game/ (empty = vanilla)
#   AUTO_UPDATE       0 | 1 - refresh Plutonium bootstrap files on start
#   USE_XVFB          0 | 1 - wrap wine in xvfb-run
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -u

CONTAINER_DIR="/home/container"
PLUTO_DIR="${CONTAINER_DIR}/plutonium"
GAME_DIR="${CONTAINER_DIR}/game"
STORAGE_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/storage/t5"
DEFAULTS_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/default-configs"

cd "${CONTAINER_DIR}" || exit 1

# T5 known bug: does not auto-create logs/ directory or log file. Always
# ensure both exist before launch.
mkdir -p "${STORAGE_DIR}/logs"
touch "${STORAGE_DIR}/logs/games_mp.log"
touch "${STORAGE_DIR}/logs/games_zm.log"

# --- sanity: bootstrap present ----------------------------------------------
if [ ! -f "${PLUTO_DIR}/bin/plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe" ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: Plutonium bootstrap not found at ${PLUTO_DIR}/bin/"
    echo "[entrypoint] Run the Reinstall action on this server from the Pelican panel."
    exit 1
fi

# --- optional: refresh Plutonium bootstrap files -----------------------------
if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}" = "1" ] && [ -x "${PLUTO_DIR}/plutonium-updater" ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] Checking for Plutonium bootstrap updates..."
    ( cd "${PLUTO_DIR}" && ./plutonium-updater -d . -q --no-color ) \
        || echo "[entrypoint] WARN: updater failed; continuing with existing files."
fi

# --- sanity: game files uploaded --------------------------------------------
# T5 sentinel: binkw32.dll (same as T6).
if [ ! -f "${GAME_DIR}/binkw32.dll" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "[entrypoint] ============================================================"
    echo "[entrypoint]  BO1 GAME FILES NOT FOUND"
    echo "[entrypoint] ============================================================"
    echo "[entrypoint]  Upload your legally-owned Black Ops 1 files to:"
    echo "[entrypoint]    ${GAME_DIR}/"
    echo ""
    echo "[entrypoint]  Required entries (minimum):"
    echo "[entrypoint]    binkw32.dll, localization_mp.txt, localization_zm.txt"
    echo "[entrypoint]    main/iw_*.iwd"
    echo "[entrypoint]    zone/all/*.ff (mp + zm fastfiles)"
    echo "[entrypoint]    zone/english/*.ff"
    echo ""
    echo "[entrypoint]  Safe to omit: players/, redist/, sound/, video/,"
    echo "[entrypoint]                *.ipak, sp_* zone files."
    echo "[entrypoint] ============================================================"
    exit 1
fi

# --- sanity: server key set --------------------------------------------------
if [ -z "${PLUTO_KEY:-}" ] || [ "${PLUTO_KEY}" = "CHANGE_ME" ] || [ "${PLUTO_KEY}" = "changeme" ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: PLUTO_KEY variable is not set."
    echo "[entrypoint] Generate one at https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys"
    case "${GAME_MODE}" in
        t5mp) echo "[entrypoint] Pick game = T5MP." ;;
        t5sp) echo "[entrypoint] Pick game = T5SP (zombies uses the SP engine)." ;;
        *) echo "[entrypoint] Pick game variant matching GAME_MODE=${GAME_MODE}." ;;
    esac
    exit 1
fi

# --- seed config from template (first boot only) -----------------------------
TARGET_CFG="${STORAGE_DIR}/${SERVER_CONFIG}"
TEMPLATE_CFG="${DEFAULTS_DIR}/${SERVER_CONFIG}.template"

if [ ! -f "${TARGET_CFG}" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "${TEMPLATE_CFG}" ]; then
        echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: no template at ${TEMPLATE_CFG}"
        echo "[entrypoint]        Valid SERVER_CONFIG: dedicated.cfg (MP), dedicated_sp.cfg (ZM)"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "[entrypoint] Seeding ${SERVER_CONFIG} from template (first boot)"
    mkdir -p "${STORAGE_DIR}"

    # Same transform as T6/IW5: inject sv_hostname, replace rconWhitelistAdd
    # block. Both T5 cfgs have the // B3, IW4MADMIN banner with rcon_rate_limit
    # as the last rcon_* set line before the whitelist block.
    python3 - "${TEMPLATE_CFG}" "${TARGET_CFG}" "${SERVER_NAME:-Plutonium T5 Server}" "${IW4M_IP:-}" <<'__PYEOF__'
import sys, re
src, dst, hostname, iw4m_ip = sys.argv[1:5]

with open(src, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Strip existing rconWhitelistAdd lines (xerxes ships 4 example IPs)
lines = [ln for ln in lines if not re.match(r'\s*rconWhitelistAdd\b', ln)]

# T5 cfgs do not have sv_hostname by default. Insert one near the top after
# the GENERAL CONFIGURATION banner.
hostname_escaped = hostname.replace('"', '\\"')
hostname_line = (
    f'sets sv_hostname "{hostname_escaped}"           '
    f'// Hostname shown in IW4MAdmin / console title.\n'
)

# Insert above first "set g_inactivity" line which is the first line of the
# GENERAL CONFIGURATION block in BOTH dedicated.cfg (MP) and dedicated_sp.cfg
# (ZM). Using g_password as anchor would fail for ZM (no password feature).
out = []
inserted = False
for ln in lines:
    if not inserted and re.match(r'\s*set\s+g_inactivity\b', ln):
        out.append(hostname_line)
        inserted = True
    out.append(ln)
if not inserted:
    out.insert(0, hostname_line)

# Build whitelist block, splice in after rcon_rate_limit
whitelist_block = ['rconWhitelistAdd "127.0.0.1"                        '
                   '// Loopback is always whitelisted.\n']
if iw4m_ip.strip():
    whitelist_block.append(
        f'rconWhitelistAdd "{iw4m_ip.strip()}"                        '
        f'// IW4MAdmin host (set via IW4M_IP env var).\n'
    )

final = []
inserted_wl = False
for ln in out:
    final.append(ln)
    if not inserted_wl and re.match(r'\s*set\s+rcon_rate_limit\b', ln):
        final.extend(whitelist_block)
        inserted_wl = True

if not inserted_wl:
    final.append('\n')
    final.extend(whitelist_block)

with open(dst, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.writelines(final)

print(f"[entrypoint]   hostname      : {hostname}")
print(f"[entrypoint]   IW4M whitelist: {iw4m_ip if iw4m_ip.strip() else '<none>'}")
__PYEOF__

    if [ ! -f "${TARGET_CFG}" ]; then
        echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: template transform failed; ${TARGET_CFG} not written."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# --- launch ------------------------------------------------------------------
cd "${PLUTO_DIR}" || exit 1

# Sanity-check mode/cfg pairing
case "${GAME_MODE}:${SERVER_CONFIG}" in
    t5mp:dedicated.cfg) : ;;
    t5sp:dedicated_sp.cfg) : ;;
    *)
        echo "[entrypoint] WARN: GAME_MODE=${GAME_MODE} with SERVER_CONFIG=${SERVER_CONFIG}"
        echo "[entrypoint]       Expected pairs: t5mp+dedicated.cfg, t5sp+dedicated_sp.cfg"
        echo "[entrypoint]       Continuing anyway."
        ;;
esac

echo "[entrypoint] Starting Plutonium T5 (Black Ops 1) dedicated server"
echo "[entrypoint]   mode    : ${GAME_MODE}"
echo "[entrypoint]   config  : ${SERVER_CONFIG}"
echo "[entrypoint]   port    : ${SERVER_PORT}"
echo "[entrypoint]   game    : ${GAME_DIR}"
echo "[entrypoint]   fs_game : ${FS_GAME:-<none>}"

# T5 uses +exec (not +set sv_config) and +map_rotate (not +start_map_rotate).
# Confirmed against xerxes-at/T5ServerConfig/!start_mp_server.bat and
# !start_zm_server.bat.
WINE_CMD=( wine bin/plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe
    "${GAME_MODE}"
    "${GAME_DIR}"
    -dedicated
    +set key      "${PLUTO_KEY}"
    +set net_port "${SERVER_PORT}"
    +exec         "${SERVER_CONFIG}"
    +map_rotate )

if [ -n "${FS_GAME:-}" ]; then
    WINE_CMD=( "${WINE_CMD[@]:0:8}" +set fs_game "${FS_GAME}" "${WINE_CMD[@]:8}" )
fi

if [ "${USE_XVFB:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    exec xvfb-run --auto-servernum "${WINE_CMD[@]}"
else
    exec "${WINE_CMD[@]}"
fi
__PLUTO_ENTRYPOINT__
chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/entrypoint.sh"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# README
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/READ_ME_FIRST.txt" <<'__PLUTO_README__'
Plutonium T5 (Black Ops 1) server - next steps
==============================================

1. Upload your LEGALLY-OWNED Black Ops 1 game files to:
     /home/container/game/

   Required entries (minimum):
     binkw32.dll, localization_mp.txt, localization_zm.txt
     main/iw_*.iwd
     zone/all/*.ff   (mp + zm fastfiles)
     zone/english/*.ff

   Safe to omit: players/, redist/, sound/, video/, *.ipak, sp_* zone files.
   Slimmed install ~3GB vs full ~11GB.

2. Generate a server key at https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys
   - Pick game = T5MP for multiplayer, T5SP for zombies (zombies uses
     the SP engine on Plutonium).
   - Set the key as PLUTO_KEY on the Startup tab.
   - Hostname IS shown in the in-browser server list.

3. Set GAME_MODE (t5mp | t5sp), SERVER_CONFIG (dedicated.cfg | dedicated_sp.cfg),
   SERVER_NAME, and IW4M_IP on Startup tab.

4. Start the server. On first boot, the cfg is seeded at:
     /home/container/plutonium/storage/t5/dedicated.cfg     (MP)
     /home/container/plutonium/storage/t5/dedicated_sp.cfg  (ZM)

   Edit it to set rcon_password (required for IW4MAdmin) and tweak
   sv_maprotation.

5. T5 connection model:
   - Clients CANNOT directly connect by IP. They connect via session IDs
     from Plutonium's backend.
   - You still need to forward UDP 28960 (or whatever SERVER_PORT is)
     for actual game traffic. Session IDs are just NAT-traversal helpers.
   - Server still appears in the in-game browser and at
     https://list.plutools.pw/t5mp / /t5sp once registered.

6. IW4MAdmin server entry block:
     {
       "IPAddress": "127.0.0.1",
       "Port": <SERVER_PORT>,
       "Password": "<rcon_password from cfg>",
       "ManualLogPath": "/home/container/.wine/drive_c/users/container/AppData/Local/Plutonium/storage/t5/logs/games_mp.log",
       "RConParserVersion": "Plutonium T5 Parser",
       "EventParserVersion": "Plutonium T5 Parser",
       "ReservedSlotNumber": 0
     }

   For ZM, change ManualLogPath to .../logs/games_zm.log and Port to
   the zombies server's port. Same parser strings (one parser handles both).

   WARNING: T5 ZM RCon is partial - log monitoring works, but !commands
   and remote actions are unreliable. This is a Plutonium engine
   limitation, not a config issue.

"Heartbeat successful" in the log = live and registered.
__PLUTO_README__

echo "[install] ============================================================"
echo "[install]  T5 install complete."
echo "[install]  xerxes-at templates staged at plutonium/default-configs/."
echo "[install]  Log dir + files pre-created (T5 won't auto-create them)."
echo "[install]  Upload BO1 game files to /home/container/game/ then start."
echo "[install] ============================================================"

variables.name: Plutonium Server Key
variables.description: Server key from https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys. Pick the matching game variant when generating (T5MP for MP, T5SP for ZM). The hostname registered on the platform is the REAL in-browser hostname; the cfg sv_hostname only sets the IW4MAdmin/console title.

variables.name: Server Name (cfg sv_hostname)
variables.description: Hostname injected into sv_hostname in the cfg. Supports ^1-^9 color codes. Note: in-browser hostname comes from the platform server key, not this value.

variables.name: IW4MAdmin Host IP
variables.description: IP address of the IW4MAdmin host. Added to rconWhitelistAdd along with 127.0.0.1. Leave empty if IW4MAdmin runs on the same host or if you don't use IW4MAdmin.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Plutonium T5 game variant. t5mp = multiplayer, t5sp = zombies (yes, 'sp' - BO1 zombies runs on the singleplayer engine on Plutonium, unlike T6 which uses 't6zm'). Must match the server-key game variant.

variables.name: Server Config File
variables.description: Cfg file inside plutonium/storage/t5/ that the server +exec's. Pair: dedicated.cfg with t5mp; dedicated_sp.cfg with t5sp. Templates from xerxes-at/T5ServerConfig are seeded on first boot.

variables.name: Install Mapvote
variables.description: INSTALL-TIME ONLY. When set to 1, downloads Resxt's T5 mapvote scripts (mapvote.gsc + mapvote_mp_extend.gsc) into plutonium/storage/t5/scripts/mp/. MP only - Resxt does not support T5 zombies. Reinstall to toggle.

variables.name: Install Bot Warfare
variables.description: INSTALL-TIME ONLY. When set to 1, downloads ineedbots/bo1_bot_warfare v1.1.1 (mp_bots.iwd) into plutonium/storage/t5/mods/mp_bots/ and extracts its maps/ folder to plutonium/storage/t5/maps/ (per the canonical T5 Bot Warfare install guide).

variables.name: Auto-Update Plutonium
variables.description: Run plutonium-updater on every server start to refresh bootstrap files. 1 = enabled (recommended), 0 = disabled.

variables.name: fs_game (mod path)
variables.description: Mod folder relative to the game dir, e.g. 'mods/mymod'. Leave empty for vanilla. Passed as +set fs_game only if non-empty.

variables.name: Use Xvfb
variables.description: Wrap Wine in xvfb-run. Leave at 0 unless the server fails with display/X11 errors (dedicated normally doesn't need it).

variables.name: Wine Debug
variables.description: WINEDEBUG value. Default suppresses all Wine chatter. Set to 'fixme-all' to debug Wine issues.
